Definition: properly, to be broken up (with any violent action) i.e. (figuratively) to fear
BiblicalUsage: Yâra means to be broken up, to be shattered within, and so to fear or to grieve. Elkanah asked Hannah why her heart was grieved, and David spoke of the harm Sheba would do if he reached the fenced cities.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gathers the broken pieces, and a grieved heart is not hidden from Him.
